summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container. Changes: rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds Update(prologue, algebra) beside Query; rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py imports Update and makes translateUpdate always return it, building the prologue from q.prologue[0] on the empty-request path before the early exit; rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update container; rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate beside prepareQuery (processor's update method unchanged); rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate; test/test_sparql_prepare.py adds unittest tests for prepare+Graph.update, reuse, repeated application, initNs, direct evalUpdate, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, empty string via Graph.update/processUpdate, and a no-mutation snapshot check. Nothing was run, so tests are unverified. Not covered by a test: initial bindings via Graph.update. Nothing committed.
